title: fairctl verify -output json
description: F-014 T-11 (design §3.4, §3.5): the one JSON document `fairctl verify -output json` prints. internal/releaseverify's Report is the authority; cmd/fairctl's tests check its output against this schema.

release.description: The release the verified release manifest names (absent when the manifest did not verify).

refusal.description: The failed check; present exactly when verified is false.

images.description: The images verified: the release manifest's, then the package's others.

subject.description: The file or image component the check is about.

message.description: The line the text output prints after "ok - " or "FAIL - ".

detail.description: Why a check failed, when more is known.
